status: analyzed and reported; downstream release audit pending
title: J2 E2 causal post-flux completion
question: Can the corrected causal stage-1 D4 action be completed by an action-bound physical post-flux record, public charge recovery, and next-round advance in both public modes and all registered schedule branches without truth or future leakage?
answer: Yes for the bounded deterministic paper-L=2 interface. This is not a decoder-performance, threshold, hardware-fidelity, or fault-tolerance result.

registration_correction.invalid_wording: the same physical post-action record is supplied to both public modes
registration_correction.observed_counterexample: syndrome-only and heralded choose different flux actions in all four registered schedule branches
registration_correction.corrected_matched_design: hold the pre-action physical history, measurement layout, and report rule fixed, while conditioning and binding each post-action report to its own physical intervention
registration_correction.scientific_effect: restores causal intervention semantics without changing the central question, matrix, budget, or endpoint

analysis.public_translation: E2A maps a typed charge/vacuum report and explicitly supplied physical layout into the existing post-flux observation only when the report is bound to the exact stage-1 flux action.
analysis.branch_coverage: E2B executes syndrome_only and heralded under immediate, fixed_delay_1, jit_lyons_brown, and offline_full_history: all 8/8 cells complete through the public two-stage interface.
analysis.scientific_output_check: Every cell returns a nonempty blue charge correction; green correction is empty on this registered fixture. Correction size is a correctness witness here, not a performance metric.
analysis.temporal_ordering: Immediate, fixed-delay, and JIT attach the next available causal prefix only after charge completion. Offline consumes full history, remains explicitly noncausal, and has no next-prefix claim.
analysis.matched_design: Both modes share one pre-action history digest, measurement layout, and report rule. Their post-action report digests differ only as required by their different stage-1 interventions.
analysis.boundary_controls: Wrong action/request/layout, temporal inversion, illegal or multi-label post-action records, parity-inconsistent support, future-only causal leakage, private-truth leakage, and replay nondeterminism are rejected or absent as registered.
analysis.uncertainty: Not applicable to exact deterministic interface checks; no stochastic estimator, confidence interval, or logical score was produced.

matrix_summary.future_only_counterfactual: six causal cells unchanged; two offline cells change

verified_claims: the existing public schemas compose into a deterministic two-stage paper-L=2 transition
all eight registered mode/schedule branches complete through the public interface
post-action reports are exactly action-bound and contain only permitted public charge/vacuum information
causal branches do not depend on future-only changes and advance only after charge completion
private truth does not affect public transitions and deterministic replay is exact
prohibited_inferences: heralded decoding is better than syndrome-only decoding
one schedule is better than another
next_gate: Audit downstream consumers and release only the corrected deterministic E2 evidence; keep stochastic and performance sampling blocked.
